roadAttribution.description: OpenStreetMap driveable street network clipped to the City of Chicago, simplified (degree-2 nodes merged), largest strongly connected component. Directed edges, CSR-sorted by source.
storyNotes: 29,557 intersections and 77,140 directed edges (27,799 two-way street pairs plus 21,542 one-way edges); 10,323 directed km of road in the largest strongly connected component.
Directed km by class: motorway 432, trunk 38, primary 230, secondary 1,686, tertiary 1,298, residential 6,478, service/other 161.
The Chicago grid shows: 4,541 four-way intersections (15% of nodes with 4 out-edges).
Expressways (I-90/94 Dan Ryan and Kennedy, I-55 Stevenson, I-290 Eisenhower) are modelled as motorway edges and are the fast corridors for isochrones.
Median edge length 102 m, longest 5,049 m.

placeAttribution.description: Overture Maps Foundation places (release 2026-09-23.1) inside the City of Chicago, open, confidence >= 0.5, mapped to 14 broad categories from Overture taxonomy.
placeAttribution.license: Overture Places: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 (most sources), Apache-2.0 (Foursquare), CC0 (AllThePlaces) per docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/places
storyNotes: 105,808 open places; by category: finance_business 38,117, health 12,403, restaurant_cafe 11,585, retail 10,308, worship_community 7,027, personal_services 6,664, other 5,295, arts_culture 3,315.
1,255 grocery/convenience places vs 11,585 restaurants/cafes: food-access (food desert) stories by tract.
240 transit-tagged places (bus/train stations) are noisy relative to the CTA GTFS; treat as a proxy.
Places are denser downtown and along commercial corridors: strong spatial clustering for Ripley K / cross-K.
Overture merges several commercial sources, so POI counts follow business-data coverage, not ground truth: weak in some South/West side tracts.

source.coordinateSystem: WGS84 AEQD 41.885,-87.635; float32 local meters; induced road window

conventions:
Spaghetti GlobalAutoK reference, run with the designated Python -I.

Native planar meters, float32 AEQD coordinates centered on downtown Chicago.
Undirected unique endpoint chords (not OSM polyline/travel-time costs), both CSR
orientations. Spaghetti snaps original f32 event positions independently. Its
Euclidean arc lengths are rounded to f32 before routing and simulation; endpoint
offsets remain Spaghetti's f64 geometric measurements. Radii are integer meters,
strict <, unordered pairs, no self pairs, n**2 normalization, no edge correction.
Network length is the f32-rounded sum of unique f32 arc lengths; the reference
retains its f64 sum and records both plus event intensity.

Real input: deterministic spatially stratified Chicago places in a 2km square,
roads in a surrounding 3km square, largest connected component only. This is a
window study, not full-Chicago routing. All selected observations and radii are
retained, never selected by observed GPU output. Synthetic exact-boundary and
coincident events exercise strict <. Monte Carlo: 1024 Spaghetti uniform-length
patterns (NumPy seed 20261015), compared to 3 independent GPU seeds with a
family-wise two-sample DKW bound, not same-seed equality. Raw simulation arrays
are retained; Spaghetti significance-scaled envelopes are NOT GPU min/mean/max.
